name: M-Pesa (Daraja)
summary: Ask customers to pay by M-Pesa (STK push) and check the result.

triggers.name: An M-Pesa payment request finished
triggers.description: Result code 0 means paid; others mean cancelled, timed out or failed.

actions.name: Ask a customer to pay (STK push)
actions.description: Sends an M-Pesa payment prompt to the customer's phone. They approve it with their PIN.

params.name: description
params.description: Shown on the prompt, up to 13 characters
